🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 24, 2026

Moon, in Pisces, holds a square to Uranus, in Gemini. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: the wanting and the sum are audible in the same room.

Easier — Noticing which of your commitments you never actually chose.
Harder — Forcing a decision that only needs to be described honestly.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you, fallen in Cancer. Sun faces you from Libra, holding the other figures. Cardinal fire: the beginning has a price on it. Three weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from Scorpio, where none of its habits work. From Pisces, Moon hands you an opening. Fixed earth: nothing needs letting go of today. Since Venus crossed out of Libra, the question has changed.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Libra. Moon in Pisces presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Air that changes shape, charged for each shape. Four weeks of Virgo ended, and nothing carried over.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, is only passing through Pisces. Sun in Libra stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Cardinal water meets a bill. The sextile to Mercury that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, unsupported in Libra. Mercury in Libra makes room for you, and then waits. Fixed fire holds, and holding asks nothing back. Four weeks ago Sun was still in Virgo: the ground has moved.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Libra untitled. From Pisces, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Mutable earth keeps two accounts open and pays both. The hold Moon had a week ago is not there any more.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Sun sits inside your sign, and worth stops being an abstraction. Cardinal air opens and closes the same file. Saturn let go of it four weeks ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, falls in Cancer. Moon trines you from Pisces, meeting no resistance. Water keeps what it has, cheaply. Two weeks ago Mars was still held by Saturn; that is finished.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo with no title of its own. From Pisces, Moon cuts across the appetite. Mutable fire: keeping options is the expense. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Moon in Pisces leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Earth moves first here, and first is enough. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you from Aries, without leverage of its own. From Libra, Sun concedes the point early. Air keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Water shifts until the two options are one. Jupiter is 6° further on than in early September, which is barely further on.
